---
title: "Research"
---

My research examines journalism and communication in relation to rural areas and development in the Global South. I am especially interested in how journalism, media institutions, and communication practices are shaped by transnational flows, platforms, and local contexts.

## Current projects

### Local journalism in global perspective

**Status** · Ongoing  
**Keywords** · local journalism, global journalism, news environments

This project examines local journalism across different parts of the world, with attention to the changing relationships among local news organizations, communities, platforms, and wider political and economic environments.

### Newspaper activities during the early Vietnamese revolution

**Status** · Ongoing  
**Keywords** · Vietnam, revolutionary press, newspaper history, journalism history

This project studies newspaper activities during the early period of the Vietnamese revolution, focusing on the development of the press, its political and social contexts, and its relationship to revolutionary mobilization.

## Methods and materials

My primary approach is qualitative research, drawing on interviews, fieldwork, archival materials, and historical documents. I am also open to learning quantitative methods when collaborating with other researchers. My field research has included rural areas in Jingdezhen, southern Henan, Yunnan, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Beijing, Anhui, and Gansu, China.
